chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Our intercession is for the people of major sins from among our Shi'ah; as for those who repent, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
There is no way against the doers of good.

key_terms.أَهْلِ اَلْكَبَائِرِ: the people of major sins; those guilty of grave transgressions
key_terms.اَلتَّائِبُونَ: those who repent; people who return to Allah in repentance
key_terms.اَلْمُحْسِنِينَ: the doers of good; those upon whom no blame remains
key_terms.سَبِيلٍ: a way; here meaning grounds for blame or punishment
key_terms.شَفَاعَتُنَا: our intercession; the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shi'ah; the followers and adherents of the Imam

ai.seo_question: Is the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt for repentant believers or for major sinners among their Shi'ah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that the Ahl al-Bayt's intercession is for those among their Shi'ah who have fallen into major sins. Those who have repented are described through the Qur'anic wording as being free from blame, highlighting the acceptance of tawbah and the mercy of Allah عزّ وجلّ.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4964 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Our intercession is for the sinners who commit major sins from among our followers. As for those who repent, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, says:
'There is no blame upon the doers of good.'" (Surah At-Tawbah 9:91)
